page: Microsoft Azure E128ns_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the Env6 family, deployed on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel processor architecture and provides 128 dedicated vCPUs. System resources include 1024.0 GB of memory, delivering a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. No graphic processing units are bundled with this instance type.

This configuration does not include local disk storage, necessitating the attachment of remote storage volumes. It is designated as Premium Storage capable and network optimized, catering to enterprise architectures requiring low-latency network interconnects and persistent external storage. Because local scratch storage is omitted, all persistence and temporary caching must be managed across attached network storage solutions.

With its high allocation of 1024.0 GB of RAM alongside 128 dedicated compute cores, the E128ns_v6 balances large-scale memory demands with high parallel compute capacity. Cost efficiency is realized by consolidating massive enterprise workloads onto a single dense node rather than provisioning multiple smaller distributed nodes. The primary operational tradeoff involves the reliance on external storage, which requires careful provisioning of remote volumes to avoid I/O bottlenecks.

The hardware profile of the E128ns_v6 targets memory-intensive enterprise workloads that require extensive multi-threaded computing capability. Suitable applications include large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, large analytics caches, big data processing engines, and relational database systems demanding high RAM capacity and network optimization.
description: Microsoft Azure E128ns_v6 is a memory-optimized instance from the Env6 family, operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. Powered by an x86_64 Intel processor, it features 128 dedicated vCPUs and 1024.0 GB of system RAM, yielding an allocation of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The instance is network optimized and capable of attaching Premium Storage, though it includes no local disk storage, requiring external volumes for system and data persistence. Furthermore, it operates without discrete GPU accelerators. This configuration provides significant compute density alongside a substantial memory pool, making it efficient for consolidating large single-node environments. However, architectures must account for external storage throughput dependencies due to the lack of onboard NVMe drives. The E128ns_v6 is designed for memory-intensive enterprise tasks, including large in-memory databases, business intelligence platforms, high-capacity caching layers, and substantial relational database management systems.
